root_causes.title: Missing Infigraph CLI wrapper
root_causes.description: The knowledgebase integration needs a way to invoke a pinned, reproducibly resolved Infigraph CLI and report whether the required analysis capabilities are available.
root_causes.solution_summary: Create a wrapper script that resolves the `infigraph` CLI executable and executes it, with proper error handling for missing/unsupported/misconfigured states.

tasks.title: Add Infigraph CLI wrapper
